pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: main 2-story block, N-S ridge near x 546 from about y 500 to 590; E face is one big 8/12 plane (1026 sq ft) from the ridge to the E eave; N face shallow and dark; W face mostly covered by the west cross

pieces.name: west_cross
pieces.notes: cross hip on the W half, E-W ridge near y 497 meeting the main ridge, hipped at the W eave with hips meeting near (455,497); lit S face

pieces.name: nw_wing
pieces.notes: 1-story garage wing NW, E-W ridge near y 397, hipped both ends (W hips meet near (420,397)); its S face sits in the main block shadow

pieces.name: east_bump
pieces.notes: small hip bump on the E face at the eave, E-W ridge near y 560, the dark triangle is its N face
